AvatarRoot.description: Holds the picture's loading status and shares it with the image and fallback inside it. Size and shape the avatar on this element.

AvatarImage.description: The picture. Its source is loaded off-screen first, and the `` is added only once it has loaded, so a broken image never shows.

props.src: The picture's URL. Without `src` or `srcset` the fallback shows.
props.srcset: Candidate sources for the picture, as on an ``.
props.crossorigin: The CORS mode for loading the picture, as on an ``.
props.referrerpolicy: The referrer policy for loading the picture, as on an ``.
props.onLoadingStatusChange: Called with `"loading"`, then `"loaded"` or `"error"`, each time the source is loaded.

dataAttributes.data-starting-style: Present for the first frame after the `` appears: style the state it animates in from.
dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the `` animates out because a new source started loading. It is removed when its transitions end.

AvatarFallback.description: Shown while the picture hasn't loaded: while it loads, when it fails, and when there is none. Usually initials or an icon.

props.delay: How long to wait before showing the fallback, in ms, so a picture that loads quickly doesn't flash it first.
